test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was nominated to the Rajya Sabha by President Ram Nath Kovind in March 2020?
solution:
The correct option is Justice **__Ranjan Gogoi__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Under** Article 80** of the Indian constitution, the president appoint twelve nominated members to the Rajya sabha.
 
• Mr Gogoi served as the **46th chief justice of India.**
